name: How quickly can mold grow after water damage occurs?

mainEntity.name: How quickly can mold grow after water damage occurs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold can begin to grow within 24 to 48 hours after water damage if moisture is not properly addressed. It thrives in damp, dark environments with a food source like wood, drywall, or fabric. The speed of growth depends on factors such as temperature, humidity levels, and the type of porous materials present. Prompt water extraction and drying are crucial to prevent or minimize mold proliferation. Delaying intervention significantly increases the risk and extent of mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold can start growing within 24 to 48 hours after water damage if moisture is not removed. Its growth speed depends on environmental conditions and available materials.
